gate.command: PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 PYTHONPATH=eva2/src:eva2 PYTEST_DISABLE_PLUGIN_AUTOLOAD=1 python3 -m pytest -q --capture=sys -p no:cacheprovider eva2/tests/operations/test_operator_cli.py eva2/tests/operations/test_ab_slots.py eva2/tests/operations/test_release_verifier.py

proved: The operator CLI initializes a private canonical installation state.
A canonical release manifest is staged only after a valid Ed25519 trust-root threshold, validity interval, revocation and schema-compatibility check.
Activation leaves traffic closed and opening traffic requires a separate revision-bound command.
A tampered image digest fails signature verification and leaves the target slot empty at the original revision.
Cutover and rollback preserve one explicit database lineage.
nonclaims: The gate uses an ephemeral test signing key and does not create a production release key.
The gate does not promote the current B candidate or change Telegram traffic.
A production activation receipt still requires independent live health and acceptance evidence.
